canonical_files.input_trace.json: one canonical JSON object validated by human_input_trace.schema.json
canonical_files.selected_human_traces.json: one canonical JSON object validated by selected_human_trace_manifest.schema.json
canonical_files.state_trace.json: one canonical JSON object validated by human_state_trace.schema.json

hash_scope: raw bytes of the named file; hashes are stored only in detached result/manifests and SHA256SUMS.txt

json_document.numbers: input/state trace records contain integers only; nonfinite numbers forbidden; negative zero forbidden
json_document.unicode: unescaped UTF-8 where valid; control characters escaped by JSON
json_document.whitespace: compact JSON; separators comma and colon; no insignificant spaces
